title: The Silent Small Half
tagline: A lonely forwarding wallet from the Homestead era that remains untouched by any human hand.

chapters.heading: The ghost of the homestead era
paragraphs: Candelabras flicker against the shadows of May 26, 2016. On this day, a wallet named 0x5149…f0f1 brought a new life into the world. It was born during the Homestead era of Ethereum. This contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum.
The contract took its place in a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It now sits as a quiet ghost at 10.4 years old. It remains a small half of a Big/Small pair, waiting in the silence.

chapters.heading: The house of silence
paragraphs: The contract appeared on May 26, 2016. It has lived for 10.4 years in the quiet. Nobody ever called it.
No one ever knocked on its door. It holds 0.0 ETH. Its code still rests on the chain.
